name: Poseidea
summary: Poseidon's midwinter feast on his monthly sacred eighth — cakes and sacrifice for the earth-shaker as the sailing year rests, the Ionian Poseidea kept most richly on Delos and faintly at Athens.
testimonia: IG XI accounts from Delos (expenses for the Poseidea)
Parke (1977) 97–98 (Attic evidence thin beside the Delian feast)
